answer: A glacier census sweeps district by district, too slow for one operator to file twice. Each identity files a tally of its timber stand and locks a 70-credit bond. A violet seal ties each tally to its key; auditors burn the bond for a reused stand or copied seal. First survey 30, kth 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, so rented tally rings lose. Honest agents survey one stand once, keep the bond.
